core_claim: The Forbes AI 50 looks like a diverse field of fifty companies, but by the numbers it is two stories stacked — a couple of foundation-model giants holding almost all the money, and four dozen young applied startups crowded into one California city.

edt_01.editorial_notes: 79.4%, $305.7B, $735M median, $6.1B mean, 8.3x must be exact. Guess-first interaction on the OpenAI+Anthropic share.
